trail.text: Everything spiked at once — I need to separate the origin from the victims.

causes.reasoning: Travel shows large sustained internal latency (admin_trip p50 67ms->275ms, trip_detail 271ms->700ms) while its downstream route/train/ticketinfo are healthy, and all degraded callers (seat, preserve, food, admin-travel) call travel.
Seat latency rose 0.06->0.30 with left_tickets p95 54ms->447ms but it makes 4644 calls to degraded travel-service, so likely victim amplifying travel slowness rather than origin.
Preserve preserve-endpoint p50 493ms->1114ms rose at same 20s onset but preserve calls travel-service, so it is downstream victim of travel.
Admin-travel admintravel p50 148ms->358ms p95 174ms->1147ms but it only calls travel/travel2 (travel2 healthy), proving victim of travel with no callers to propagate further.
Food latency 0.08->0.33 with healthy internal traces shows it is a caller-side victim via its calls to travel-service, not an origin.
